nodes.title: SG-8.3 · Rewrite context.md and add the GDD
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still says the repo holds only a README with an unknown stack, while game/ holds a Phaser 3.90 + React + Zustand + Radix + Vitest game (game/src core, game/frontend client). No GDD exists. Desired behavior: context.md names the real stack and module layout; game/docs/GDD.md lists every feature with its implementing files and every named path exists. Expected result: docs match the code. Why: last step of SG-8 so the docs can be trusted.

## Acceptance criteria
- context.md names Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest and the real modules
- The GDD feature index lists every feature with code files and every path it names exists


## Scope
- In scope: context.md rewrite (written by Devion from these tickets)
- In scope: game/docs/GDD.md
- In scope: Unit-tested docs checks
- Out of scope: Any gameplay, UI, art or content change
- Out of scope: backend/ (Go) and frontend/src/api/client.ts
- Out of scope: Other SG-8 steps (8.1, 8.2)
- Preserve: Boys-room gameplay behaviour
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard test
- Preserve: Existing sourceSize and importBoundary tests


## Technical constraints
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in both game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; no source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend; Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No change to what the player sees or can do; backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- Docs checks pass against the real context.md and GDD


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Docs checks report missing paths and missing stack terms
nodes.body:
Context: nothing verifies docs against code. Desired behavior: pure helpers in game/frontend/src/lib parse the GDD feature index table, report paths that do not exist, and report stack terms missing from a text. Expected result: wrong docs fail a unit test. Why: keeps the GDD matching the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a markdown feature index table with backticked paths, when indexedPaths runs, then every backticked repo path is returned once
- Given an exists predicate, when missingPaths runs, then only the paths it rejects are returned
- Given a text lacking 'Vitest', when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then ['Vitest'] is returned


## Scope
- In scope: docsCheck.ts helpers
- Out of scope: Any gameplay, UI, art or content change
- Out of scope: backend/ (Go) and api/client.ts
- Out of scope: Other SG-8 steps (8.1, 8.2)
- Preserve: Boys-room gameplay behaviour
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard test
- Preserve: Existing sourceSize and importBoundary tests


## Technical constraints
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in both game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; no source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend; Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0


## Definition of done
- Helpers exported, file under 200 lines, typecheck green

steps.action: Create contextModulePaths(md: string): string[]. For each line starting with '|', match /`((?:game|backend)\/[^`\s]*)`/g and return the captures de-duplicated in first-seen order.
steps.code: export function contextModulePaths(md: string): string[] { const out = new Set<string>(); for (const l of md.split('\n')) { if (!l.startsWith('|')) continue; for (const m of l.matchAll(/`((?:game|backend)\/[^`\s]*)`/g)) out.add(m[1]); } return [...out]; }
steps.expected: Function exported and npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend
